trace.question: Between DC and Marvel Comics, which publisher has published more superheroes? Find the difference in the number of superheroes they have published.
trace.evidence: DC refers to publisher_name = 'DC Comics'; Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'), SUM(publisher_name = 'DC Comics'))

attempts.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

trace.final_sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
